```{r}
#| label: setup

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
```

## Storms Over Time

The following chart displays the number of unique named storms recorded each year in the `storms` dataset, categorized by their status.

```{r}
#| label: named-storms-per-year
storms %>%
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) %>%
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane"))) %>%
  group_by(year, status) %>%
  summarise(n_storms = n_distinct(name), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n_storms, fill = status)) +
  geom_area() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "lightblue",
      "tropical storm" = "orange",
      "hurricane" = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Named Storms per Year by Type",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Unique Named Storms",
    fill = "Storm Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Wind Speed Distribution by Category

The boxplot below shows the distribution of maximum sustained wind speeds for each storm category.

```{r}
#| label: wind-speed-by-category
storms %>%
  filter(!is.na(category)) %>%
  mutate(category = as.factor(category)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = category, y = wind, fill = category)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Maximum Sustained Wind Speeds",
    subtitle = "Analysis of wind speeds (knots) across storm categories (1-5)",
    x = "Storm Category",
    y = "Wind Speed (knots)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
